'''Mistress al'Taron''' is a resident of the [[Two Rivers]] and the mother of [[Dael al'Taron]].

== Activities ==
Her son goes with [[Perrin Aybara]] and is killed when the Trollocs ambush Perrin's group. She calls out for Dael when the survivors return to Emond's Field.{{ref/book|4|43}}
